conventions: TypeScript strict, ESM; Prettier 2 via @excalidraw/prettier-config (double quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent, 80 cols); eslint-plugin-prettier enforces it, max-warnings 0.

Import order: package aliases (@excalidraw/common, @excalidraw/math, @excalidraw/element) first, then relative imports, then `import type` statements grouped last, blank line between groups (eslint import/order).
Inside packages/element/src import sibling modules relatively (./textRanges); outside packages/element import from "@excalidraw/element" and types from "@excalidraw/element/types".
AGENTS.md: never use the document/window globals in new code; use app.ownerDocument / app.ownerWindow, an element's ownerDocument, or svgRoot.ownerDocument.
AGENTS.md: combine object types with Merge<Base, Overrides> from "@excalidraw/common/utility-types", never Omit<...> & {...}.
Elements are immutable: change them only through mutateElement / scene.mutateElement / newElementWith, never by assignment.
A text element with no style ranges must not have the styleRanges key at all (not even undefined): add it with a conditional spread `...(ranges ? { styleRanges: ranges } : {})`.
UI strings go through t("labels.<key>") and only packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json gets new keys.

Tests: vitest globals (describe/it/expect), vi from "vitest"; jsdom with vitest-canvas-mock (measureText width = text.length * fontSize/10 roughly); UI tests render <Excalidraw /> via ../tests/test-utils and drive it with API/UI/Keyboard helpers from tests/helpers.
Never call yarn test:update; never add snapshot assertions to existing tests; new tests assert values directly rather than toMatchSnapshot.

decisions.choice: Element field `styleRanges?: readonly TextStyleRange[]` on ExcalidrawTextElement; type `TextStyleRange = Readonly<{ start: number; end: number; color?: string; highlight?: string }>` in packages/element/src/types.ts; AppState field `textEditorSelection: { elementId: string; start: number; end: number } | null`; actions `changeTextRangeColor` / `changeTextRangeHighlight` (exports actionChangeTextRangeColor / actionChangeTextRangeHighlight); en.json keys labels.textRangeColor = "Selection color", labels.textRangeHighlight = "Selection highlight".
rejected: a separate jotai store for the selection
decisions.reason: Requirements' working names, kept; Gate 0 put the selection in AppState.

decisions.choice: All range maths, wrapped-line splitting and run layout (x offset and width per run) live in packages/element/src/textRanges.ts and are re-exported from @excalidraw/element; renderElement.ts and staticSvgScene.ts both call getStyledTextLines from it. textElement.ts, textWrapping.ts, textMeasurements.ts, mutateElement.ts and reconcile.ts are not edited.
rejected: duplicating the run layout in the SVG renderer
decisions.reason: One module for canvas and SVG keeps the two renderers identical and the change small; the split aligns wrapped text to originalText itself, so the wrapping code needs no change.

decisions.choice: No ranges = the styleRanges key is absent. Code that sets ranges goes through withStyleRanges(element, ranges), which returns a NEW element object (version and versionNonce bumped, as newElementWith does) carrying the normalized list, or the element without the key when the list is empty; it returns the same object when the normalized list is deep-equal to the current one. Readers treat undefined and [] the same (no ranges).
rejected: styleRanges: [] or null as the empty value
decisions.reason: Keeps existing snapshots byte-identical (C-3), and a new object identity is what invalidates elementWithCanvasCache (a WeakMap keyed by element), so no cache code changes.

decisions.choice: Both live in packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx (App.text.ts, which owns handleTextWysiwyg, is not writable): editable.oninput shifts the latest scene element's ranges with shiftRangesForEdit before calling onChange, and textarea select/keyup/mouseup/input listeners write app.setState({ textEditorSelection }). handleSubmit sets it back to null. App.tsx is not edited.
rejected: editing App.text.ts updateElement (outside the write contract)
decisions.reason: textWysiwyg already holds `app` and the textarea; App.text.ts's updateElement spreads the latest scene element, so ranges written to the scene before onChange are carried with the new text.

decisions.topic: Two extra colour pickers next to the stroke picker
decisions.choice: ColorPicker gains an optional prop `popupId?: "textRangeColor" | "textRangeHighlight"`; when given it replaces `type` as the AppState.openPopup key (open state, toggles, close, memo comparison, data-openpopup). AppState.openPopup's union gains those two values. Selection color uses type "elementStroke" with topPicks [transparent, red, green, blue, yellow stroke shades]; Selection highlight uses type "elementBackground" with the default background picks.
rejected: new ColorPickerType values (branches in Picker, TopPicks, colorPickerUtils)
reusing the stroke picker for the selection (Q3)
decisions.reason: Two pickers of the same type would otherwise open together with the stroke picker; one optional prop keeps the palette code untouched.

decisions.choice: Picking COLOR_PALETTE.transparent ("transparent") in either selection picker clears that attribute on the selection (patch value null); any other string sets it.
decisions.reason: Matches how the background picker expresses none.

decisions.choice: A styled line is laid out with absolute run positions: lineWidth = sum of run widths measured with getLineWidth in the element's font; lineStart = 0 (left), (element.width - lineWidth) / 2 (center), element.width - lineWidth (right). LTR lines place runs left to right from lineStart; a line for which isRTL(line text) is true places runs in logical order from the right edge (first run ends at lineStart + lineWidth). Each run is drawn left-anchored at its x (canvas textAlign "left"; SVG tspan x with text-anchor "start").

A highlighted run gets a rect at (run.x, lineIndex * lineHeightPx), width run.width, height lineHeightPx, filled with applyDarkModeFilter(highlight, isDark); drawn before any text of that line (canvas fillRect; SVG <rect> appended to the element's <g> before that line's <text>).
decisions.reason: FR-18/FR-19: highlight sits behind the text and spans one line height.

decisions.choice: textEditorSelection defaults to null, so pretty-format adds the line `  "textEditorSelection": null,` right before each top-level `  "textToolHover": null,` line in regressionTests/history/contextmenu .snap files; that insertion is a deterministic perl tooling step per file, never vitest -u / yarn test:update.
rejected: leaving the field out of getDefaultAppState
decisions.reason: Gate 1 approved exactly this one-key diff; a fixed text insertion cannot hide any other snapshot change.

decisions.choice: Both selection actions return captureUpdate CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY when they change the element and CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY when they only pass app-state updates (popup open/close) or do nothing; the editor's input-time shift is not captured separately (the existing submit capture records it).
decisions.reason: Same contract as actionChangeStrokeColor; history then restores ranges like any other element property (FR-17).
